name: Shutter Speed Value
detail: 4-byte little-endian ratio: uint16 numerator + uint16 denominator. Auto/Bulb use sentinels.

name: Shutter Speed Current Value
detail: Same ratio encoding as 0xD016. Reflects actual value under auto behavior.

name: Gain dB Value
detail: Signed integer in 1/10 dB units. Example: +12dB -> 120.

name: ISO Current Sensitivity
detail: Research suggests a compound ISO/Gain-related field in at least one interpretation path; exact layout still needs detail-page verification.

name: Shutter Speed Setting
detail: Same ratio encoding as 0xD016. Primary shutter-speed property on v3.

name: Movie Recording State
detail: Known states include idle, recording, standby; use as tally/record-state source of truth.

name: Battery Remaining
detail: Expected as 0-100 percent; 255 may mean AC power rather than battery percentage.

name: Focus Position
detail: Absolute focus position in lens-dependent device units. Not portable across lens changes.

name: Focus Position Current Value
detail: Read-back in the same device-internal unit.

name: Follow Focus Position Setting
detail: Absolute follow-focus target in the same internal focus-unit family.

name: Image ID String
detail: UTF-8 string payload. Max length is defined separately by 0xE0FE.

name: Collision candidate
detail: Possible code-name collision in the compacted research output. Keep out of working catalogs pending detail-page verification.
